selfDescription.text: EFF describes itself as a nonprofit defending civil liberties in the digital world through litigation, policy analysis, activism and technology development.

editorialDescription.text: WRN curates EFF for reporting and analysis on digital rights, privacy, surveillance and freedom of expression.

selfDescription.text: C4SS describes itself as an anarchist think tank and media center producing and distributing left market anarchist media.

editorialDescription.text: WRN curates C4SS as an organization-published source for anarchist commentary and multilingual translations.

selfDescription.text: Africa Is a Country describes its work as an African left perspective on social, political and cultural issues, including sport.

editorialDescription.text: WRN curates Africa Is a Country for African left analysis, anticolonial perspectives and its sport and society coverage.

selfDescription.text: A collective of Black and Afrikan organizers, journalists, academics and media personalities producing news and programmes for Black and Afrikan audiences.

editorialDescription.text: WRN lists this active media collective for Black liberation reporting and commentary; only organization-level metadata and original links are stored.

selfDescription.text: An organization building a solidarity economy in Jackson through cooperatives and worker-owned, democratically self-managed enterprises.

editorialDescription.text: WRN lists this as an organization profile about cooperation, mutual aid and solidarity economy; it is not treated as an independent news outlet.

selfDescription.text: A space for Montréal anarchists to circulate ideas and actions through news, reports, communiqués, writing and counter-information archives.

editorialDescription.text: WRN lists this active counter-information publication while preserving anonymous attribution and avoiding any assumption of reuse rights.

selfDescription.text: An Uruguayan anarchist federation describing its struggle for social revolution and a libertarian socialist society.

editorialDescription.text: WRN lists the federation as an organization-published source for anarchist statements, analysis and activity notices.

selfDescription.text: A Bogotá political organization founded in 2010 that identifies with social and organized anarchism and Colombian popular struggles.

editorialDescription.text: WRN lists Vía Libre as an organization profile for anarchist education, statements and movement analysis.

selfDescription.text: A Ukrainian anarchist and anti-authoritarian volunteer network doing humanitarian, media and material-support work during Russia’s invasion.

editorialDescription.text: WRN lists public organization-level metadata only and excludes tactical locations, non-public identities and operational details.

selfDescription.text: An autonomous counter-media project of Anti-authoritarian Platform amplifying social movements and marginalized or repressed communities.

editorialDescription.text: WRN lists this active counter-media platform using public organization-level metadata and original links.

records.canonicalName: Anarchist Front of Iran and Afghanistan

selfDescription.text: A first-party publication of the Anarchist Front of Iran and Afghanistan with statements and political analysis.

editorialDescription.text: WRN keeps this source distinct from the Federation of Anarchism Era and stores no personal identities or fine-grained location data.

selfDescription.text: A forum for discussion, debate and analysis among Kurdish-speaking libertarians and anarchists across several states.

editorialDescription.text: WRN marks this source rare because the latest publication was not established; no relation to the Federation of Anarchism Era is inferred.

selfDescription.text: A revolutionary anarchist organization working in north-east Syria whose site archives statements, articles, interviews and video.

editorialDescription.text: WRN lists public organization metadata only and excludes operational details, geotags, identities and live frontline information.

selfDescription.text: An international coordination of social anarchist organizations and federations with member and associated-project directories.

editorialDescription.text: WRN lists IFA as an organization and directory profile, not as an independent single-member news feed.

selfDescription.text: A library supporting anarchist thought, organizers and learners across South Asia.

editorialDescription.text: WRN lists this as a library and archive. Item-level rights remain unknown and no works are copied into WRN from this profile.

selfDescription.text: A regional library of anarchist literature from and about Southeast Asia and in regional languages.

editorialDescription.text: WRN lists this as a multilingual archive and stores only source metadata and the original link.

selfDescription.text: A Korean-language library collecting texts by Korean and international anarchist organizations and individuals.

editorialDescription.text: WRN lists this as a library and archive; it does not imply representation by a political organization.

selfDescription.text: An Australian anarchist communist membership organization with branches in Brisbane, Melbourne, Geelong and Sydney.

editorialDescription.text: WRN clearly labels this as organization-published material and links to its original publication and contact route.

selfDescription.text: An Australasian and Oceanian online resource project by and for anarchists, currently administered by Melbourne Anarchist Club.

editorialDescription.text: WRN lists this as a resource and directory project rather than a current news outlet.
